## Line 145

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/transforms.library.plato, line 145](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/transforms.library.plato#L145).

```plato

    //==
    // Projective transforms — full homographies on homogeneous coordinates;
    // the widest transform family here, closed under composition.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homography

    // The product of two 3x3 matrices (row times column). Also discharges the
    // IMultiplicative obligation on Matrix3x3.
    Multiply(a: Matrix3x3, b: Matrix3x3): Matrix3x3 {
        var c1 = Number3(b.Row1.X, b.Row2.X, b.Row3.X);
        var c2 = Number3(b.Row1.Y, b.Row2.Y, b.Row3.Y);
        var c3 = Number3(b.Row1.Z, b.Row2.Z, b.Row3.Z);
        return (Number3(a.Row1.Dot(c1), a.Row1.Dot(c2), a.Row1.Dot(c3)),
                Number3(a.Row2.Dot(c1), a.Row2.Dot(c2), a.Row2.Dot(c3)),
                Number3(a.Row3.Dot(c1), a.Row3.Dot(c2), a.Row3.Dot(c3)));
    }
```

```plato

    // The dual-quaternion product: like the quaternion Hamilton product,
    // a.Multiply(b) is the motion b followed by a. Use Compose for
    // first-then-second ordering.
    Multiply(a: Motor3D, b: Motor3D): Motor3D
        => (a.Real * b.Real, a.Real * b.Dual + a.Dual * b.Real);
```

## Line 1097

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/transforms.library.plato, line 1097](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/transforms.library.plato#L1097).

```plato

    //==
    // # Rotation operations and conversions
    //
    // Application, composition, inversion, and interchange for every rotation
    // representation declared in `rotations.types.plato` — Rotation2D, Rotor2D,
    // Quaternion, AxisAngle, EulerAngles, Rotor3D — together with their embeddings
    // into the affine and homogeneous matrices. Quaternion is the hub: every 3D
    // representation converts to and from it, so all pairs compose through it.

    //==
    // 2D rotations — Rotation2D is the angle form, Rotor2D the geometric-algebra
    // form (a unit complex number built from the half angle).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_matrix

    // Composition of two plane rotations: angles add (2D rotations commute).
    Multiply(a: Rotation2D, b: Rotation2D): Rotation2D
        => Rotation2D(a.Angle + b.Angle);
```

```plato
    // The geometric product of two rotors (complex multiplication); the result
    // rotates by the sum of the operands' angles.
    Multiply(a: Rotor2D, b: Rotor2D): Rotor2D
        => (a.Scalar * b.Scalar - a.XY * b.XY, a.Scalar * b.XY + a.XY * b.Scalar);
```
